focus.notdown: The lone bullish single-name is DE — and it’s a thin one. On top of that, an open-ended U.S.–Iran economic-warfare escalation with Brent near $93 keeps a live oil tail. Not RED, because the tape is orderly and futures are flat rather than falling — but the honest stance is YELLOW: verify DE’s liquidity before anything, keep cash otherwise, and re-run tomorrow pre-open.

Earnings risk is now behind it, and there’s a stack of 5 S/R layers within 7% (swing $590.06, gap-floor $580.63, then $572, $565, $558). But two red flags make this a poor premium-sell as boarded: reaction volume is only ~0.03× the 50-day (the 1.3× confirmation bar is not met), and options are thin/one-sided — OI just 169, below the 500 bar, with an unquoted ATM market. The implied move (~4.4%) was larger than the realized 3.0% gap. Treat as illiquid; do not size a spread until the chain is confirmed on-platform.
